title: How to Combine eBay Sports Card Orders Without Guessing at Postage
excerpt: A practical routine for combining paid eBay sports card orders, checking the finished package and confirming shipment on each order.
author: ManCave Sports Cards LLC
metaTitle: How to Combine eBay Sports Card Orders | Scorecard
metaDescription: Find eligible eBay orders from the same buyer, compare postage after packing, and verify tracking for low-cost sports card singles.

sourceLinks.label: eBay Help on printing combined shipping labels
eBay Help on offering combined shipping

body.content: A set builder buys three baseball singles from you in the morning, then comes back for two more that afternoon. You now have two paid orders. One shipment might save a label and some packing time, provided the cards can travel safely together and you can meet both orders’ shipping commitments.

body.text: Use the buyer tag to find orders

body.content: In its November 2026 seller update, eBay announced an order tag that flags buyers with multiple orders that may be shipped together. In Seller Hub Orders, eBay’s label instructions say to open the buyer’s order-count tag, select the orders going into the package, and choose Shipping, then Get Label. On the bulk label page, select Combine orders per buyer.

Before selecting anything, check that the orders are paid and still awaiting shipment. Compare the shipping addresses shown on the orders and check the service and ship-by date for each. If the addresses differ, the orders are ineligible, or a single shipment cannot meet both commitments, handle them separately. Pack and ship by the earlier deadline when combining.

body.text: Pack the cards before choosing the label

body.content: Pull every card for both orders and match its year, set, number and version against the order details. Then dry-pack the whole shipment with the protection you’ll actually use. A thick card or a rigid holder can change your options even when the number of cards looks manageable.

Weigh and measure the finished package at its thickest point. If you’re considering eBay Standard Envelope, check the service’s current eligibility rules and verify that the finished piece meets them, including flexibility and even thickness. Compare the cost of the eligible combined shipment with the cost of separate eligible shipments. If the combined package needs a parcel label, the separate shipments may cost less. Choose an option that protects the cards and meets what you promised at checkout.

body.text: Keep the shipment and any refund separate

body.content: Combining orders in one package is a fulfillment decision. Adjusting a shipping charge is a separate decision. If the buyer already paid and you agreed to a shipping discount, eBay says you can issue a partial refund from Orders. For listings that already offered free shipping, the main calculation is what you spend on postage, materials and packing time.

Before sealing the package, check off each order against the cards inside. After buying the label, reopen both order records and confirm that the shipping status and tracking information reflect the shipment. This is especially useful when two similar-looking cards differ by a parallel or image variation.

Use the tag to spot orders you can review together. Check the buyer, address and deadlines, then decide based on the finished package. On inexpensive singles, saving a label helps only if every card arrives protected and every order is accounted for.
